properties.notes: Demolition of existing buildings and erection of up to 12 self-build dwellings. 7 of these on brownfield land. Planning Ref: 16/00633/OUTMAJ (2017-03-31); 17/00806/REMMAJ (2017-11-08); 17/01172/REM (2018-02-07); 17/01173/REM (2018-02-28); 17/01174/REM (2018-02-28); 17/01175/REM (2019-02-28). The site has planning permission for 12 dwellings but 2 dwellings are to be demolished therefore the net number of dwellings is 10. 6 dwellings under construction at March 2019.
